description: Source code for GatewayConnectionController class managing gateway connections, discovery, TLS verification, and miscellaneous system integrations for an iOS app.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionController
classes.description: Manages gateway discovery, connection establishment, TLS fingerprint verification, and system permissions for the iOS app.

classes.name: GatewayTLSFingerprintProbe
classes.description: Performs TLS fingerprint probing over a network request to verify server identity.

methods.name: connectWithDiagnostics
methods.description: Initiates connection to a discovered gateway with diagnostics, returning an error string if any.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Handles the connection process to a specific discovered gateway, resolving service endpoints and managing TLS fingerprint checks.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Public method to connect to a gateway, linking to connectWithDiagnostics.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Connects to a gateway via manual host/port details, optionally verifying TLS fingerprints.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the last known gateway based on stored settings.

methods.name: refreshActiveGatewayRegistrationFromSettings
methods.description: Updates the current gateway configuration based on local settings and permissions.

methods.name: clearPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Resets any pending TLS trust prompts.

methods.name: acceptPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts the current trust prompt, saving the TLS fingerprint and reconnecting.

methods.name: declinePendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Dismisses any pending trust prompt and sets status to offline.

methods.name: updateFromDiscovery
methods.description: Updates internal state from the current gateway discovery process.

methods.name: observeDiscovery
methods.description: Sets up observation to automatically update the state upon discovery changes.

methods.name: maybeAutoConnect
methods.description: Attempts automatic connection based on user preferences and previous connections.

methods.name: updateLastDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Stores the first discovered gateway's stable ID if user preferences allow.

methods.name: startAutoConnect
methods.description: Initiates automatic connection to a gateway with provided parameters.

methods.name: resolveDiscoveredTLSParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a discovered gateway, considering stored pins and configuration.

methods.name: resolveManualTLSParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for manual host/port connections.

methods.name: probeTLSFingerprint
methods.description: Performs a TLS fingerprint probe on the given URL asynchronously.

methods.name: resolveServiceEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves a network endpoint's service to host and port asynchronously.

methods.name: resolveHostPortFromBonjourEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves Bonjour service endpoints to host/port.

methods.name: buildGatewayURL
methods.description: Builds a WebSocket URL from host, port, and TLS use flag.

methods.name: resolveManualUseTLS
methods.description: Determines whether to use TLS for manual connection based on host and options.

methods.name: shouldRequireTLS
methods.description: Decides whether TLS should be strictly required based on hostname.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Checks if a host is a local loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopbackIPv4
methods.description: Checks if IPv4 address is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopbackIPv6
methods.description: Checks if IPv6 address is a loopback address.

methods.name: manualStableID
methods.description: Generates a stable ID string for manual host/port connections.

methods.name: makeConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options including capabilities, commands, permissions, and client info.

methods.name: resolvedClientId
methods.description: Resolves or overrides a client ID for connecting to a gateway.

methods.name: resolveManualPort
methods.description: Resolves the correct port number for manual connection considering TLS requirements.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayName
methods.description: Resolves and persists a display name based on device info and existing user defaults.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines current capabilities based on app settings and device features.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands supported based on current capabilities and features.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Gathers current app permission statuses for various system features.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if location authorization is granted for either 'Always' or 'WhenInUse'.

methods.name: hasEventKitAccess
methods.description: Checks if app has access to EventKit calendars or reminders.

methods.name: motionAvailable
methods.description: Checks if device supports motion activity and pedometer features.
